name: Cyprus Environment Foundation grants
summary: Grants from a private foundation for local projects in Cyprus on biodiversity conservation, regenerative land use and sustainable resource management. Calls are announced to newsletter subscribers.

applicant_types.quote: WHO: Local non-profit organizations, associations, clubs or unions, social cooperative enterprises and other local bodies, including research centres are strongly encouraged to apply for funding.

geography.quote: WHERE: The CEF will support projects throughout the entire island of Cyprus.

access.quote: All applicants need to complete and submit our application form.

window.quote: Subscribe to our newsletter to receive notification for the upcoming grant proposal call.
